description: This file defines the class SudoRetrieveThingsResponse, which represents the response to a 'sudoRetrieveThings' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from various inputs, parsing from JSON, and accessing the retrieved 'Thing' objects.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThingsResponse
classes.description: A response object representing the outcome of a 'sudoRetrieveThings' command, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and access to retrieved 'Thing' objects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SudoRetrieveThingsResponse instance from various inputs such as plain JSON string, list of JSON strings, JsonArray, or list of Thing objects, with optional predicates or field selectors.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance of SudoRetrieveThingsResponse from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getThings
methods.description: Returns a list of 'Thing' objects contained in the response.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity of the response from a JsonValue.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Updates the response with new DittoHeaders.
